items.text: Engineers move into management through an MBA, internal promotion or a short management programme, and the right route depends on the role you want, your years of experience and whether your employer values the degree or the results you have delivered.
Many engineers move up through delivery results first and add an MBA only if the role demands it.
Check official pages and ask your employer.
